reason: The cited evidence does not address FeMnNiGeSi alloys, sputter deposition, or magnetocaloric transitions. E1 discusses grain size correlations in an annealed electrochemical system and explicitly states no mechanistic link is established; E2 concerns deformation-induced FCC-to-HCP transformation in FeMnCoCr, not magnetocaloric effects. Thus, none of the key premises are supported by the provided evidence.
premises: Enhanced cooling during sputter deposition refines grain size in FeMnNiGeSi thin films
Grain refinement increases local chemical and strain heterogeneities
Increased heterogeneities lower and broaden the nucleation energy barrier of the first-order magnetostructural transition
